name: Chesa Monte
beschreibung:
Hotel Chesa Monte welcomes guests with a seamless fusion of alpine tradition and contemporary lifestyle. Beautifully crafted rooms, an exclusive wellness zone, and exceptional regional cuisine guarantee memorable stays.

The location grants immediate access to spectacular alpine adventures, whether carving down world-class ski slopes or hiking across panoramic summits.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Chesa Monte offers refined alpine comfort, fine dining, and restorative wellness amidst the Tyrolean mountains.
